title: spec 17.0.0 GA made the element props schemas strict — two spec-parity tests still encode rc.6 strip-mode as their control
body:
Found while re-pointing PR #4639 (the `@objectstack/spec` GA pin bump, #4636). Filed
unassigned; **not** fixed on that branch, because the pin-bump card's file surface is the
`package.json` range lines plus the lockfile, and this is a real GA behaviour change rather
than a mirror of those lines.

## What changed at GA

`@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` flipped the `element:*` props schemas from **strip** mode to
**strict**. An undeclared key used to parse green and simply vanish from `data`; it now
fails with `unrecognized_keys`. The spec's own diagnostic states the intent:

```
Unrecognized key(s) on this `element:record_picker`: `notASpecKey`. Until #4001 batch A an
undeclared prop was dropped in silence: the props schema stripped it and
`PageComponent.properties` is an open bag, so the key reached objectui's renderer, was not
read there, and the author got a success receipt for configuration that did nothing.
```

Measured directly against the installed GA package:

```
ElementRecordPickerPropsSchema.safeParse({ object: 'account', notASpecKey: 1 })
  -> success: false, issues[0].code === 'unrecognized_keys'
```

This is the change working as designed. The problem is only that two of our tests pin the
**old** behaviour as their deliberate contrast probe.

## The two failing tests

Both fail on the same assertion shape — the *contrast* half of an otherwise-passing test.
Their subject claims (the key is declared, published, and survives the parse) all pass.

| file | failing assertion |
|---|---|
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/record-picker-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts:101` | `expect(undeclared.success).toBe(true)` |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/text-input-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts:83` | `expect(undeclared.success).toBe(true)` |

Each sits under a comment that states the now-falsified premise verbatim, e.g.

```
// This props schema is a strip-mode `z.object`, so an UNDECLARED key parses green too and
// is simply absent from `data` afterwards; asserting `success` alone would prove nothing.
```

## The decision this needs

The probe exists to keep the surrounding key-reachability claim non-vacuous — it shows what
an *unpublished* key looks like, so "the key survives the parse" means something. Under
strict mode that contrast has to be re-expressed. The candidate shapes:

- **A — assert the rejection.** Replace `success === true` with an assertion that the
  undeclared key now yields `success === false` and `issues[0].code === 'unrecognized_keys'`.
  Keeps the contrast (declared key survives / undeclared key is refused by name), and upgrades
  it: the probe now pins the *stronger* GA guarantee rather than the silent-strip behaviour the
  spec deliberately retired.
- **B — drop the probe.** Smallest diff, but it removes the non-vacuity guard the test's own
  comments say is load-bearing, and the remaining assertions would then pass against a schema
  that had stopped declaring anything.

A looks clearly right, but it is a test-contract change on the repo's key-reachability
convention (declared-key reachability is asserted by key survival, per the comments in both
files), so it wants a deliberate call rather than a drive-by edit — and the same convention
is spelled out in other parity tests that do not currently fail.

## Scope note

A repo-wide scan for this exact spelling finds only these two files:

```
grep -rn "undeclared.success\|notASpecKey" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx packages apps examples scripts
  -> packages/components/src/__tests__/text-input-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts:82,83,84
     packages/components/src/__tests__/record-picker-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts:99,101,102
```

Worth widening once during the fix to any parity test asserting a green `safeParse` on a
props schema carrying an extra key, since the strict flip is schema-wide and not specific to
these two blocks.

## Reproduce

Only after the GA pin resolves — on `main` (still `^17.0.0-rc.6`) both tests pass.

```
git checkout claude/issue-4636-spec-pin-ga   # PR #4639, at 47c7cc3
pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/__tests__/record-picker-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts \
                                     packages/components/src/__tests__/text-input-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts
```

Blocked-by: #4636 (the failure is only reachable once the GA pin lands).
